acceptance.condition: A valid exact TASK-112 FamilyMergeDecisionRecord with decision APPROVE plus one explicit valid family_id produces one immutable canonical product-family record without requiring graph, source-pack, resolver, grouping, or proposal inputs.
REJECT, wrong decision-record type, or any attempt to bypass explicit Human APPROVE fails closed and creates no canonical family result.

family_id is required and fail-closed for empty, whitespace-only, leading or trailing whitespace, multiline, NUL-containing, or non-string values; a valid opaque family_id is preserved exactly and is never generated or normalized.
The canonical family record preserves exactly decision_record.proposal.members in canonical order and exposes no additional inferred or rewritten members.

The canonical family record retains the exact Human decision record as approval provenance, preserving proposal pair evidence, actor, decided_at, relationships, confidence, reasons, and ResolutionEvidence unchanged and auditable.

The result is immutable and deterministic: equivalent valid inputs yield semantically identical records and no clock, random/UUID generator, hash-derived identity, environment, filesystem, network, or global mutable state influences canonical family identity.
The new boundary performs zero calls to TASK-108 resolution, TASK-109 multi-observation resolution, TASK-111 grouping, or TASK-112 proposal creation; it consumes existing approval lineage only.

Canonical family admission does not create or imply product_id, variant_id, group_id, proposal_id, aggregate/merge confidence, canonical product profile, auto-merge recommendation, persistence, catalog mutation, or external side effect.

Existing SAME_PRODUCT_FAMILY, EXACT_VARIANT_MATCH, and UNCERTAIN evidence inside the approved proposal remains unchanged; family admission never converts family membership into transitive sellable-variant truth.

Focused regressions cover valid APPROVE admission, REJECT/wrong-type failure, family_id validation and exact preservation, exact member/provenance retention, immutability, deterministic repeated construction, zero resolver/grouping/ proposal re-execution, no generated identity, no variant identity, and zero persistence/external side effects while retaining TASK-112 behavior.

TASK-108 remains the sole pairwise entity-resolution authority and distinguishes EXACT_VARIANT_MATCH, SAME_PRODUCT_FAMILY, DIFFERENT_PRODUCT, and UNCERTAIN.

hard: The public canonical-family creation boundary must consume exactly one existing FamilyMergeDecisionRecord and one explicit caller-supplied family_id. It must not accept a graph, provisional group, ProductSourcePack collection, resolver, proposal substitute, or implicit/default identity source.

Canonical family creation is permitted only when decision_record.decision is exactly FamilyMergeDecision.APPROVE. REJECT and any non-explicit/non-enum decision must fail closed; no property of proposal evidence may substitute for Human APPROVE.

family_id is an opaque caller-supplied string. It must be explicit, non-empty, single-line, free of NUL, and contain no leading or trailing whitespace. The accepted value must be preserved exactly; this milestone must not normalize, parse, hash, prefix, suffix, generate, or otherwise reinterpret it.

The output must be immutable and preserve exactly the approved proposal member tuple in its existing canonical TASK-111 order. No member may be added, removed, duplicated, reordered, replaced, or inferred.

The output must retain the exact FamilyMergeDecisionRecord as approval provenance so actor, decided_at, proposal, pair_evidence, relationships, confidence, reasons, and ResolutionEvidence remain auditable through the preserved record without recomputation or semantic rewriting.

The canonical family record may expose only the explicit family identity, exact approved member tuple, and approval provenance plus trivial derived read-only properties such as member_count. It must not expose product_id, variant_id, group_id, proposal_id, aggregate confidence, merge confidence, canonical profile fields, auto-merge recommendation, persistence handle, or catalog authority.

Equivalent calls with the same valid family_id and the same exact approved decision record must be semantically identical. No wall clock, random source, environment state, filesystem state, process state, network state, or global mutable registry may affect the result.

The boundary must perform zero entity-resolution, graph-resolution, grouping, proposal-construction, scoring, ranking, ingestion, persistence, network, browser, Drive, LLM, queue, or external-service calls.

Family admission does not assert that all approved observations are the same sellable variant. Existing SAME_PRODUCT_FAMILY and UNCERTAIN pair evidence must remain unchanged in approval provenance; no transitive variant claim may be introduced.
No operation in this task may mutate the supplied decision record, proposal, pair evidence, member identities, source data, catalog, or external state.

task.problem: TASK-112 intentionally stops at Human approval: APPROVE authorizes only a future milestone to treat the exact proposal member set as one canonical product family. The system therefore still lacks a narrow canonical family identity boundary. That boundary must not infer or generate a stable ID from the current observation set because membership may grow later, and it must not combine family admission with variant resolution or persistent catalog mutation. The next milestone should bind one explicit externally allocated family identifier to one exact approved family while preserving all prior evidence and authority boundaries.
